title: Create Customised Server Version
description: The server-side version for the Create Customised modpack
body:
This version of _[Create Customised](https://modrinth.com/modpack/create-customised)_ allows for the modpack to be hosted on a Minecraft server with all the mods and customisation seen in Create Customised.

This version should be installed on the serverside only. For integrated servers, you can use the normal version with no issues. To host on a dedicated server, install this version on the serverside and the regular version on all of the clients.

If there are any errors in the server, feel free to let me know on our [Discord server](https://discord.com/invite/wGmTr477HX).
